question: Which office owns the support desk figures (ticket metrics, response and resolution time against a service-level target) and the storage figures (bytes used, quota and the cleanup of files nobody references) of an organization, which stored records are the source of each figure, and who may read them and trigger a cleanup that removes files?
decision: Platform support owns support-service figures computed from actual support_tickets; org admins see their own scoped metrics. Platform operations owns storage metering from real object-store bytes and reconciliation; deletion needs a tenant-authorized retention/hold check, dry-run manifest, second approval for permanent deletion and audited result. Implement required launch support and storage surfaces or hide them explicitly as unavailable; never return fabricated figures or pretend a 501 is a passed capability.
originalProposedDecision: Support figures: platform support owns them, computed from support_tickets via the existing service; org admins see their own. Storage: platform operations from actual blob sizes; cleanup only by platform ops, with a dry-run list first. Until wired, return 501.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
